name: ScrollReveal-TS-TW
title: Scroll Reveal
blurb: Text words fade in and unblur with a stagger as the container rotates, all tied…
description: Splits text into words and reveals them with staggered opacity and optional blur animations as the element scrolls into view. The container itself rotates from a base angle to zero. Uses GSAP ScrollTrigger.
use_when: Body copy needs a polished reveal effect that's synchronized to scroll progress for reading guidance.
avoid_when: When content must be legible without scrolling; constant blur impairs readability.
a11y: Text is split into word spans and animated. Content is readable once fully revealed but animation may distract.
